entities.name: Guano Islands, Islets, and Capes National Reserve System
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The Guano Islands, Islets, and Capes National Reserve System is a protected area of the Peruvian State that includes 22 islands, islets and groups of islands as well as 11 points along the Peruvian coast from Piura to Tacna. It has a discontinuous area of 140,833.47 hectares.
